name: Remove Object
description: Fills a masked part of a picture from its surroundings (LaMa Fill), or grows the mask a little first (the group Remove Object). Used as the pre-fill of the Remove action: a clean base for the edit model to polish. LaMa (big-lama; code and weights Apache-2.0, github.com/advimman/lama; the ONNX export is by Carve, Apache-2.0) through ONNX Runtime (MIT), on the CPU or an NVIDIA GPU, in the pack's own Python environment. Nothing is bundled: the model is downloaded from the model picker after a question that names its licence.

setup.description: Create the pack's Python environment (ONNX Runtime for the CPU, NumPy, Pillow) in its folder; needs uv and the network.
